Your every decision affects the angels, design their wardrobe and direct your relationship. The game comes with an easy mode, so you can choose scenarios. For example, if you want things to stay light and fluffy, you can just choose the simple mode to get rid of the heavy scenes. And when your Love Points with your angel reaches a certain level, you'll be in for some special service scenarios.

460832.overview: A mahjong game with the host girls of the dream club.

461013.overview: Momotarō Dentetsu 16 GOLD is a video game in the Momotaro Dentetsu series of board game-style video games, genre released in 2007 by Hudson Soft for the Xbox 360.

461014.overview: Shio is busy preparing for the school festival. In the morning, when he opens a door to wake Ririsu, his old friend, up as usual, she is still asleep. He tries to wake her up, but she gives him a strong kick... On their way to school, Shio thinks, "Ririsu used to be pretty..." She is, however, now an egoistic girl... One day, Ririsu suddenly introduces Chisa to Shio. "Will you please dance with me at the school festival...?" Shio is confused what to say while Ririsu shows mixed feelings...

461016.overview: Muv-Luv Alternative continues the story of Shirogane Takeru after the events of the original Muv-Luv. This is a tale of a love so deep it breaks all barriers; about courage in the face of adversity and overcoming hardships. Takeru encounters insurmountable odds while his entire world is turned upside down around him.

461017.overview: The story is set within the Muv-Luv Alternative universe, focusing on the soldiers taking part in the multinational, UN-led Project PROMINENCE, at Yukon Base in Alaska, during 2001. Their role is to test-pilot some of the latest prototype and experimental TSFs and improve them further, in order to improve humanity's fighting chance against the BETA.

461018.overview:
This game consists of two parts: Muv-Luv Extra and Muv-Luv Unlimited. Unlimited is unlocked after you get the endings of the two main heroines (Sumika and Meiya) in Extra.

Muv-Luv Extra:
Shirogane Takeru is a typical high school student with a lazy attitude and a love for the virtual reality mecha battle game Valgern-on. Even though he didn't really want it, he is popular in school mainly due to his daily fights with his osananajimi (Sumika) attracting too much attention. His life takes an unexpected turn when he finds a girl (Meiya) he doesn't remember ever meeting in his bed one morning. That girl is later revealed to be the heiress of one of the biggest zaibatsu. She immediately moves to his house and starts changing his life for the good with her one-track-mind and unlimited resources...

Muv-Luv Extra, the main part of Muv-Luv, takes place in the same world (and general area) as Kimi ga Nozomu Eien and Kimi ga Ita Kisetsu. The Sky Temple family restaurant is mentioned and visited, and Suzumiya Akane makes an appearance.

Muv-Luv Unlimited:
One day Takeru wakes up late, wondering why Sumika or Meiya didn't wake him up this morning. Not seeing any signs of them he gets a bit worried and goes out of his house only to see the town he lived in all his life in ruins. After getting past the initial shock he decides that this must be a dream and decides to enjoy it as much as he can...

461019.overview: Meikyuu Cross Blood (迷宮クロスブラッド), a.k.a. Labyrinth Xross Blood, is a first-person dungeon crawler released by Experience Inc.

461020.overview:
Memories Off 6: Next Relation (メモリーズオフ6 Next Relation) is a Japanese visual novel created by 5pb. as the sequel (2nd chapter) to Memories Off 6: T-wave. It was released for Playstation and XBox 360 on August 27, 2009.

The story takes place a summer half a year after "T-wave", where the protagonist and the selected "T-wave" heroine continue their relationship until they reach the Ryuukyou Hot Springs.

467044.overview: Water Bear Interactive LLC presents Match with Wally for the X-Box 360. Match with Wally allows the child to match Upper and Lower case letters, Star blocks with Number Blocks, Shapes and colors with their name block. The software uses randomization to reduce patterns and encourage learning. Match with Wally is part of the Alexander Learning Series.

467878.overview: Make your way through 20 mazes to rescue the princess from the evil brontosaurus. Collect coins along the way to purchase power-ups and suits.

468430.overview: MINER WARFARE is a frantic 2D shooting and digging multiplayer experience. With the innovative 2 player per controller system up to 8 miners can dig their way through dirt blocks and other miners in order to be the wealthiest at the end of the match. Ten maps, 28 weapons, up to 8 players (yep, 8 players with 4 controllers) and only 1$, MINER WARFARE is the perfect couch game friendship breaker!

469940.overview: This Special Edition is a budget release of Marvel Ultimate Alliance in the Greatest Hits series. Next to the main game, it contains a bonus disc with behind-the-scenes videos and a collection of trailers.

476601.overview:
Founded after the first alien invasion on earth in the year 2054. M.A.C.E. is the epitome of the new cohesion of all peoples of the earth to fight against the aliens to serve life on earth in a military path.

While heavy fights rages on earth against incoming alien ships and the M.A.C.E. units are to prevent the construction of additional land bases for the alien ships, a group of specially trained fight pilots with space warships try to prevent the arrival of more aliens and destroy the alien mother ships and troops of aliens.

Fight in an exceptional space mission by foreign galaxies to prevent the arrival of more alien swarms on the earth. Your spaceship is one of the first one which is built by people using alien technology including engines, weapons and shields to survive against the aliens.

MACE is a classic space shoot 'em up, inspired by the legendary Amiga games of this genre. Handdrawn 2D graphics in HD resolutions, parallax scrolling, explosion effects and optimized games mechanics, combined with the proven gameplay are transporting the "Spirit of Amiga" in today's Age.

476714.overview: Full featured tarot reader with over 150 unique card descriptions and 5 distinct reading types for all occasions.

476717.overview:
A fast moving, classic, arcade style, platform game - Jump and glide over 60 action packed levels.

Discover all 'Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji' as either 'Magic Thighs' or 'Slightly Phil' (One or two player - co-op) and save Japan from the nefarious Zodiac gang.

476718.overview:
High above the lame Mortal Realm rests the cloud-wreathed towers of the Wizard Keep. It is a place where robes never go out of style, and beards are totally awesome.

But then the badguys attack, and Versimos is kidnapped!

Luckily for Versimos, he has three students who will stop at nothing to get a passing grade, and if that means rescuing their teacher from the treacherous Morg Mountains, then so be it.

Guide three sociopathic apprentices through an open world filled with caves, castles and underground cities as you search for your kidnapped teacher. Discover countless secrets, loot hidden treasure troves, and decapitate your enemies. Or immolate them. Or smack them in the face with fruit.

476722.overview: Send a message to all of your friends or a group with only one press on a button! Communicate faster with your clan or closer friends. Use the banlist to exclude the not-so-friendly friends from receiving your message.

476724.overview: A maid wandered into a cave where the Benars live. Can she escape the cave safely by using her specialty "trembling" to get away from them?

476725.overview:
A new Top-Down racing game is here!

Enjoy the rally with 18 unique racing circuits and different game modes:

- Time Trial
- Fastest Laps with online Leaderboard
- Time Attack
- Head to Head
- Battle Mode
- Quick Race Race locally against other friends/CPU drivers, or play Online.

476726.overview:
Wield the power of magnetism on a journey through a forgotten utopia in this captivating puzzle-platformer.

Utilizing magnets, attract, repel, and launch yourself through 36 levels while avoiding dangerous, robot-crunching obstacles.

476727.overview: Have you ever wanted to be like your favorite musical artist or favorite athlete and show up to the club and just make it rain money in there? Well here is a game that will bring you as close to that feeling as you can get, without actually spending $10,000 in one night!

476730.overview:
Create a floor plan and erase rooms! A new housing action puzzle game, "MADRISM."

Connect the falling rooms with doors, place a toilet and kitchen, and [complete] it. Be careful, as it's game over if the rooms collide!

476732.overview:
Use your ship's magnetic powers to beat 20 varying levels filled with enemies and power-ups!

Play by yourself or with a friend in this challenging space shoot-em-up!

476734.overview:
We took Mahjong Moves and improved it. Better Visibility! Over 50 Tile Sets! Advanced Editor!

Now with 3-D, zooming tiles and a larger playfield, you can see the tiles much more clearly. You can also design layouts that zoom the tiles even more!

Play on smaller screens or from further away than was ever possible with the original game.

476735.overview: Help these maids gather balloons and use them to fend off seagulls in a set of fun minigames.

476736.overview: A horror/mystery game where you examine the PC of a suicide victim. It is filled with mad rantings and cryptic files. It also claims that whoever unlocks the files will be rewarded with the secret of happiness.... Why did he kill himself? What is the secret of happiness? Who is 'Princess'? Explore the twisted computer of a madman to find out.

476738.overview:
Get ready for some MAGICAL MAYHEM with MAGE CAGE! Grab your friends and play as one of four students of sorcery, each with unique abilities, and demonstrate your magical prowess in this hectic platform fighter. Conjure your way through various levels as your spells bounce and burst in an attempt to become the most powerful wizard in the academy.
Mage Cage couples the competitive yet beginner friendly multiplayer of Super Smash Brothers with the fast-paced chaos of Multiplayer Pong. A cast of hilariously eccentric magic students fight to prove whose spells, and perhaps personality, is the best. Featuring 4 player local multiplayer, 5 maps with different tactical qualities, polished 3D art, 3 game modes, and AI for practicing your skills, this game gives you the chance to zap, burn, and freeze your enemies (or best friends)!

476740.overview:
Really Shooter and his mother Poor Mama are running a cleaning service business, with Really taking commando jobs on the side.

One day, aliens invade (!) and Really doesn’t hesitate for one second, he heads over to their mother ship and begins to mow down the invading forces with his trusty machine-gun. And of course, as usual it is up to Mama to clean up the mess after him.

476742.overview: Magical Cube is a mission-clear style puzzle game. The object of this game is to defeat monsters in battle by using Marie's magic. When 3 Cube is aligned (only same color), Marie's magic is invoked. Marie can deliver a damaging blow to the monster with magic, and when monster's life gone run out, you win! Collect coin, and purchase accessories to make Marie more powerful!

476744.overview:
Use your trusty Magnet Cannon and Obnoxiously Big Legs to solve countless puzzles. Push, pull, lift, and leap your way to victory.

Dozens of secret rooms filled with prizes await your discovery. What are you still reading for!?

476745.overview: Machiavelli's Ascent is a vertical platformer taking place in the deepest depths of the ocean. Guide Machiavelli the jellyfish on an ascending journey by consuming nutrient bubbles, chaining them together to create melodious combinations. Progress upwards with the catapulting assistance of jumpers and score enhancing starfish. Pursue and hunt elusives as you guide Machiavelli all the while earning achievements as you play and competing locally or globally for highscores. See you underwater...

476746.overview: Developed using the XNA framework, Mad Blocker Live is an expansion of the original flash game featuring new Modes exclusive to this version of the game such as a unique 2 player battle mode and some extra special block types. Mad Blocker Live is a fresh new version of the game. See how many Fluzzel's you can free!

476748.overview: Magic Studio presents: A new Top-Down racing game is here! 4 classes: Open Wheel, Kart (85cc, 150cc, 250cc) Race over 34 circuits with different game modes: - Practice - Quick Race - Complete Weekend Race - Season Race against to 19 CPU drivers or play Online. The internal editor for full personalization of drivers and teams!

476750.overview:
It's a Soccer Game! 117 different teams, from 6 nations (USA, England, France, Italy, Germany and Spain).

Friendly match, Penalty Kicks, Tournaments.

476754.overview:
Tokyo, 2015 A.D. The First Climax is released.

We are the Alpha and the Omega. The world will never be the same...

Maison Kanraku is a NEC PC-Engine style panty-throwing simulator. Experience the high resolution of thrown-away pixelated panties as they distract an army of conservative landladies and janitors.

476757.overview:
Help Mambow and Piou to conquer their independence in an incredible 3D platform game.

Collect 50 medals distributed in savanna, jungle, mountain and temple. 10 levels to go for maximum challenge!

476759.overview: Intense top-down shooter with a magnetic twist! Defend four missiles as they head towards their intended target. Use a magnetic field to keep enemy projectiles away from the missiles. Also includes a 2-player mode. Created by a UNM Advanced Graphics Lab student.

476761.overview: 18 tile sets, 100 challenging layouts and a layout editor to create your own layouts.

476762.overview: A simulation game of harvesting and shipping crops. Aim: 10,000 pieces of coins!

476764.overview:
Main Sequence: A Game of Beautiful Disasters.

You're just a little rock with dreams of becoming a big star. Absorb smaller masses, avoid larger ones, ride the gravity waves, and try not to destroy the solar system.

476800.overview: A classic board game, Mancala is an easy game to learn but challenging to master. Challenge a friend locally or online or play against the AI opponent. Configurable with up to 8 seeds in each pit and 10 AI levels of difficulty. Uses the ELO rating system and shares high scores online.

476801.overview: MANIC MINER 360 is the near-100% original ZX Spectrum game, as written by Matthew Smith in 1983 and is being brought to Xbox Live Indy Games as an officially licenced product.

476803.overview: Some cute girls who are interested in indie games are in need of your help! Do you love indie games enough to be useful? Choose your route carefully, and you may end up a winner!

476839.overview: Marathon Monk is a classic running platformer - run for your health, run for fun, run because THEY ARE AFTER YOU!

476840.overview: Massage yourself or make a massage party stimulating each other. Easy create and save your own customized massage! Play it automatically. Manually change intensity, speed and playtime in desired moment. Available 23 hot & nice massages to please you. It will change your pad into unlimited vibrating toy!

476841.overview: Marauder Madness is an arcade style shooter featuring pirate ships created by students at the University of New Mexico. Destroy the merchant ships to plunder their gold, but be careful, too much looting and the destroyers will be hunting for you. Play alone in 21 campaign levels or against up to 3 players in a local match.

476842.overview:
Do you have what it takes to become a Marble Master?

Destroy the enemy marbles through 50 levels in this challenging physics based action puzzler.

Avoid falling into the deep dark pit while bumping the enemy marbles down the depths to their doom.

Knock your opponents into the deadly spikes shattering them to pieces.
br Use blocks as shields from the relentless marble onslaught.

Complete all levels to become a Marble Master!

476843.overview: A classic IQ game dating back to the 17th century, Marble Puzzle challenges players to remove as many marbles as possible on a triangular board. Difficulty increases with each level as each new board setup offers fewer ways to win and it ramps up even more across three challenge modes. Few will find all the possible solutions in challenge mode.

476844.overview:
March to the Moon is a shoot-em-up game where you learn abilities from 12 different skillsets.

Turn your enemies into skeletons and vampires as the necromancer, poison them and burn them as the alchemist, shoot and turn them into meat as the hunter. Yes, even the robots turn into meat.

Don't stop there! Learn a second skillset to get the dual-class paladin-necromancer you've always wanted.

476845.overview:
This is a 2D Run-and-Jump Platformer. There are 8 levels in different locations ranging from the Antarctic to Volcanos. The player earns score for collecting nuts during the game and any time left over will be added to the score.

The game has different enemies for each level. Touching the enemy will damage the player.

There are some tricky jumps so try not to fall.

476846.overview: Use realistic rifle controls to master the art of long-range shooting. Complete time trials, eliminate incoming zombie hordes, and play "rifle golf" to put your skills to the test.

476847.overview: You pilot a flying saucer on a mission to defend the Earth from the invading Martian forces. Your ship is the latest in space technology, outfitted with advanced evasive maneuver capabilities as well as upgradable weapons and armor. Watch out for the Martians with their space ships and thier grim space creatures! If you like old school space shooters, then you need to play Mars Revenge! Out now on XBox Live Indie Games.

476848.overview:
Marshmallow Duel is like a simplified version of Super Smash Bros. You play against another person, moving from platform to platform and collecting items. Some items help you, some items hurt them, and some items are just plain destructive.

Throw it all above a massive vat of marshmallow and you have Marshmallow Duel!

476849.overview: "Marvelous Galaxy" is a turn-based strategic game. There are available three game modes: Single player, Multiplayer and Fight Now. The objective of Single and Multiplayer(up to four players) is conquer all enemy planets and destroy his robots. At 'Fight Now' mode, player must choose five robots or outer-space creatures to win an immediate battle.

476850.overview:
Mash those buttons in the race to the finish.

Compete against your friends in local multiplayer and play along to either the in game loops or your own music library.

477005.overview: Tilt, tap or drag your way through space, collecting as much space junk as possible as you hurtle towards planet Earth. Become as huge as you can to inflict maximum damage!

477006.overview: Memory card game. Features 2 unique art styles and 50 unique cards to unlock. Full gallery of unlocked cards. Play solo or with a friend. The size of the card grids increase as you progress making for a good challenge. Four play modes including speed rounds that test you memory to the max.

477007.overview:
Puzzle game combining the sliding mechanic of games like Three's and 2048 with the more traditional 3 in a row matching game play.

Includes 100 level challenge mode and global scoreboards.

477008.overview:
Math Cruncher has the player race around a grid trying to complete math problems without being eaten by the monsters and not making more than three mistakes.

There are five modes: Multiples, Factors, Primes, Equality, and Inequality. The player tries to complete five stages and can post local high scores.

477009.overview: Help the flowers grow as you practice answering math problems. Learning math can be fun. As math problems are shown at the top of the screen, position the rain cloud over the flower pot with the correct answer. It may seem simple, but it is still way better than flash cards.

477010.overview: Practice math times tables and have fun at the same time. Game play focuses on solving the math problems while also providing a targeting challenge. The user plays the roll of a sniper taking out spies who know the answer to the math problem. Be careful not to hit the normal workers who don't know the right answer.

477011.overview:
Let the countdown begin!

A Mayan countdown to December 21st 2012! Is there more to this then just a screensaver? Can you unlock the 4 secret messages, that provide you with insights into the Mayan Spaceship image?

Includes a countdown timer and the current Long Count date.

477012.overview:
Max Fun Times is a customizable drinking application that enhances the enjoyment of frosty cold beverages with friends.

Spin the wheel and receive a command or customize your own wheel to create your own random fun generator!

477013.overview:
Epic, Maritime Skirmishes on a Teeny, Tiny, Teacup Scale!

In Master of the Seven Teas, you Captain a Pirate Ship inside of one of seven varied cups of tea, each presenting unique hazards. Make use of the crazy power ups, including Octopus, Ninja and Seagulls, to shoot, smash and sink your opponents.

Simple controls make Seven Teas incredibly easy to pick-up, so you can quickly take on the AI Armada solo and co-op, or enjoy the various versus options with up to 4-Players!

477014.overview: A fun game of Memory for the whole family. Up to 4 players take turns flipping cards to find their matches. This Xbox version saves you the trouble of laying out all those rows & rows of cards on the carpet. Small grid and rumble turn indicator make it child friendly or try larger grid for more challenge. We wrote this to play with our 4 kids and hope you will enjoy it as much as we do :)

477016.overview: Quick reactions, aiming skills and an overall strategy will be needed to make Max the Frog catch all those colored flies circling his beautiful pond. The game is a completely new variation of the popular match three concept. The beautiful graphic effects and intuitive gameplay make it appealing to any age. So go ahead an find out if your tongue is quicker then the flies!

477017.overview:
Challenge up to 3 other players, including stunning AI, for total domination of the board.

Collect resources, assault other towers, and use the terrain to eliminate the opponents!

477018.overview:
Your mission is to find BBQ sauce for your people and bring it back to them. Fighting off thousands of zombies with only your massive cleaver and equally massive cleavage.

The game is played with simple arcade mechanics (move left, move right, high attack, low attack), and it starts you off with an easy amount of zombies to re-kill. But each level adds more and more zombies, and eventually dogs that will chew your face off in a couple seconds

477020.overview:
Battle your way to the top using various taunts, special attacks and more!

Choose from 13 grades of customizable math challenges ranging from basic math to calculus! Challenge players over Xbox live with the advanced auto match making system that will pull you out of a one-player game and match you up with another opponent!

Leaderboards, Badges, Unlockables, and much more!

477021.overview: Take off into the wild blue yonder as the pilot of your very own Bi-Plane. Math problems will determine where you fly in the sky as you try to plow into the cloud that has the correct answer on it. Math Aerobat continues the fun that Math Sniper 3D started with a simple, but fun math problem solving game.

477023.overview: Masters of Belial is an arena type action rpg game that takes place in the ancient fantasy land of Azgoth.

477024.overview: Maya Challenge is a puzzle game that will test your brains keeping you relaxed at the same time.

477025.overview: A math flash card game for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Three difficulty settings and Local High Scores. A good way for Dad to justify the XBox as an "Educational Tool".

477028.overview: Match shapes to get a high score in this addicting puzzle type game.

477035.overview: Your mission is to defeat the lord on the top floor(Floor10) of the castle. Using skills of the ninja, Attack the enemy. Or, do not to be found by the enemy.

477036.overview: Maze of Apes is probably one of the most addictive brain teasing games. It will blow your mind how tricky yet so simple a puzzle can turn out to be.

477037.overview: Guide the ball through tricky mazes and race with your friends to see who is the fastest while everyone tries to stop the others.

477038.overview: This is a 3D robot action game.

477039.overview:
Mechanician Alex 2 is an arcade platform game.

When Alex has finished repairing his car, a terrible monster dropped a bomb on his house. Help Alex to defeat the monster by traveling to different levels.

477040.overview: Mechanician is an arcade platform game. Guide Alex to collect all the tools on each level to repair his car.

477102.overview: Mechanoid Army is a very entertaining platform based video game, which action takes place inside of a mysterious spaceship, the Nexus-9. This frenetic video game will challenge the good reflexes and ingenious of the player since the very beginning.

477118.overview: The plans for the MechFish, a remote mechanical recon device, have been stolen and used to create an evil counterpart: the DeathFish! Armed with reflexes, a high powered vertical propulsion system, and an unlimited supply of explosive bombs and missiles, you must control your MechFish through 14 sidescrolling levels of dangerous enemy waters - dodging mines and destroying DeathFish along the way!

477119.overview:
This isn't a present day apocalypse. No guns or machetes to help you here.

Loot buildings to survive and try to kill the thousands of zombies on the huge map before they eat you!

Supports over 1,000,000 zombies in a single level.

477124.overview: Meds: Recommended Dosage 100mg 3 times daily. Classic retro-style gameplay with the only enemy being your mind. 50 levels of madness, each with randomly generated withdrawal symptoms. Caution: you may never have the same experience twice. Taking pills may help, but beware of unexpected side effects. Taking meds with a friend may result in versus mode, so be sure to divide up your dosage evenly.

477127.overview: Meet Ur Match is a memory/strategy party game! Dust off those 'Scene It' controllers.....M-U-M is compatible and this allows one hand free for eating/drinking while you play.....great for parties or corporate functions. Powerups and penalties can be found amonst the images so beware! Anybody can play M-U-M so why not challenge Grandma and see if she kicks your butt.

477128.overview:
Meep - The strive for height is an addictive nobrainer classic game. With simple controls and cute graphics, you control Meep - the ever jumping - from ledge to ledge in the strive for height.

Get as high up in the air as possible to make it onto the HighScore table and beat your friends!

477129.overview:
Meep 2 - Jumping Evolved offers different gameplay from what you've seen before in platform jumpers.

Beat the clock in time trial in 20 different levels! Help yourself to be the best by viewing the ghostplayer from the best times for each level!

You can also enjoy some splitscreen multiplayer action against a buddy in tournaments!

477133.overview: Highly rated - Now UPDATED! With Avatars - High Scores & Saving Settings - New Gameplay and screens - New Analog control system plus all the cool features and strategy twists that made it so versatile in the first place! Good clean fun for the whole family (even the very little ones)....

477134.overview:
Mega Shooter 11 is an extremely authentic, retro side-scrolling space-shooter, ala the best 8 and 16-bit space shooters. It features topnotch old-school graphics, a heart-thumping soundtrack, and intelligent game play.

Spread over four huge bases with branching pathways, the game features tons of upgrades, hidden levels, enemies, and excessive amounts of replay value.

477135.overview: MegaCity is a highly original and fun 'one-more-go' style puzzle game. Easy to learn, hard to master gameplay which requires thinking, logic and luck.Place requested buildings in the queue to earn points, but watch out: Nobody wants to live next to a landfill site or industrial estate! Everybody wants a nice park or shcool nearby, but the city's budget is limited. This is where you come in. Megacity is a game of planning and thinking ahead to squeeze the most points of out your citizens by clever town planning. And if it all goes wrong, it's their fault for electing you mayor, right?Megacity is a real thinking person's game, which appeals to and is suitable for all ages.

477136.overview: With arcade style gameplay, Mega Monster Mania lets you explore and conquer a nearly infinite number of randomly generated dungeons. Fight dangerous beasts and reap the rewards! Hunt for treasure and upgrade your equipment with friends to see who can collect the most!

477142.overview: Get the highest score by managing an island for 10 virtual years in 10 minutes. To provide efficient living conditions for the human inhabitants keep a good balance between quick expansion, income and environmental sustainability.

477143.overview: Action! Puzzles! Moons! Jetpacks! Explosions! Avatars! Save the world from all of the above. Crazy high score grabbing action. Meltdown Many Moons today!

477144.overview: In 2012 four men owners of a known uploader web were sent to prison by the government of freedom for a crime they didn't commit. These men promptly escaped from prison. Today, still wanted by the government of freedom, they survive as uploaders of fortune. If you have a problem, if no one else can help, and if you can find them, maybe you can hire them.

477145.overview:
A small 2D stadium with a quick gravitational hiccup to get things moving in a new way, a few over eager players to kick a ball about and you are playing 'Melon Madness'.

In 'Tournament' mode, take on the rookies and work your way to the pros for a challenge that only fools and heroes would rise to.

In 'Exhibition' mode, invite a friend for co-op or VS gameplay with up to 4 players (2 Vs 2).

477146.overview: Exercise your brain with a game of Memory! Choose from three different game modes: Classic, Speed game, and No Mistakes. Perfect when you only have a few minutes to spare.

477147.overview: There's a radiation problem in the lab and you need to clean it up with Melvin's machine! Play in one or two player modes on multiple difficulties in this fast paced match 3 game.

477148.overview: Memory problems? Three fun games to help expand your memory.

477149.overview: Fun party game based on the classic card game. Great for a dance pad, but fun to play on a standard controller too!

477150.overview:
Enter a contest in which two teams of mermaids compete to find a randomly placed coral ball and carry it all the way to the opposing team’s court, within a sunken ship that makes the game a true 3D maze.

Can you swim fast enough to win this tournament?

477151.overview:
Merger is an unique and addictive puzzle game for all ages. The game comes packed with 60 pre-made levels in increasing difficulty to prepare you for Endless Mode where the real challenge is.

In Endless Mode you will be faced with random generated levels that you need to finish before the timer runs out.

477152.overview: A potpourri 3D board game with strategic challenge and fun-learning of general knowledge. Compete against the representative of McFishy Corp who wants to take over Merry, Inc. Earn enough gold coins to buy the Xmas tree branches and build the Xmas Tree. Invest and own major stake in Merry, Inc.

477153.overview:
Get into Christmas mood and check out this Match 3 game.

Beautiful backgrounds, Christmas trees, jingle bells and twenty challenging levels - it's all there.

477154.overview: Play the electric guitar with your Xbox 360. 168 total sound samples harnessed through simple, easy controls. Powerchords, Open and Drop-D chords, Single Strings, Palmmutes all played through 4 amplification effects. Change pitch, volume and picking speed in real-time for a HUGE variety of sound.

477155.overview: Are you a musician seeking to improve your chops or a beginner wanting to learn? Yaystuff brings you an accurate rhythm keeping device with an HD finish! You might already own a metronome, but imagine the accuracy if it harnessed the processing power of the Xbox 360! And if you're like us then you always misplace your pocket sized metronome, but that probably won't be a problem with Metronome HD!

477175.overview: Micro Invasion is a shooter type game where you struggle to fend off waves of microscopic robot spiders injected into your brain to erase your memories and human instincts in order to turn humans into robotic slaves.1 player game with 10 player online score exchange.

477177.overview: Miasma is a turn-based strategy game set in a dystopian future; where the mega-corporation Vilhelm Industries rules the world and everyone blindly and inexplicably follows their regime. Join a small band of rebels, specialise and develop their skills, and lead them in an attempt to restore everyone's individuality.

477178.overview:
ESP Games present Miasma 2, the sequel to 2010's turn-based strategy hit.

Take control of Paul or Lina once more, and command your elite squad of freedom fighters in battle against the oppressive Vilhelm Industries. With an all-new turn-based tactics/real-time battle system, the action runs fast and thick, and with new units to command - and a whole new graphics engine - this is one adventure not to be missed.

Miasma 2 gives turn-based strategy an unexpected twist as you must plan your entire team's orders at the start of the turn, then hit commit and see how it plays out. Will your courageous flanking manoeuvre pay off or will you be caught out of cover?

477223.overview:
Miner of Duty is a block-building FPS. The game includes 5 multiplayer game modes: Team Deathmatch, FFA, Fort Wars, Search & Mine, and Custom Maps. Also, Swarm Mode, a zombie-survival game mode, is playable as an offline game mode.

Custom Map mode allows you to design a map and play it with others.

You are able to customize your character's looks and your weapon classes with an array of weapons.

477224.overview:
A puzzle / action game - you're a white blood cell and your host has a tumor. Navigate through increasingly treacherous areas of the body to find and wipe it out.

Evade enemy viruses, trap them in the scenery, or exploit them to solve puzzles - use protein powerups to dissolve cell walls and alter your environment - conquer 40 levels in all.

477225.overview: Minions! is a mission-based shooter that can be played from both top-down and third-person perspectives. You create a hero, accompanied by a wide range of different minions to help you complete each mission. As the challenges get tougher, your hero will unlock points to spend on upgrades and customized minions.

477226.overview: Prepare to have to your mind blown!

477227.overview: Mister Jump is a classical retro jump'n'run where you have to help "Mister Jump" to complete all the levels!It features:? Nice retro-Gfx (thanks to flying yogi!)? 10 levels!? Universal-app with full iPad and iPhone-support!? steady framerates with 60 FPS on most devices? Full "Game Center"-supportYou can control "Mister Jump" via on-screen-buttons. Defeat enemies by jumping on them (don´t try that with the fish!). If you collect 100 rubies you´ll get an extra-life.

477228.overview: Join Tag in a mysterious adventure set in the bizarre world of planet Gi! Mithra is an action-adventure game full of fun puzzles to solve, new places to explore, an interesting story to uncover, and lots of characters to meet. Mithra is being developed and released in an episodic fashion, and this is the first chapter of Episode 1 of the series.

477229.overview: Welcome miner, start building your empire! Mine resources in a limitless world, dig and build structure to increase you production. Miner4Ever will update your resources production even when you're offline! Miner4Ever is a minecraft inspired game where the classic mining game meets the strategy and all the appeal of the most popular browser games. Dig your mine miner, build your empire miner! M4E

477230.overview:
Help the little vampire quench his thirst!

Little Draku's parents have gone on vacation, and they forgot to stock the pantry! It's time to go to town in search of fresh blood...

Stay unnoticed, and use your vampiric powers to confuse your enemies, but be wary of the dangerous vampire hunters that watch over the city!

477231.overview: Missile Escape is simple : go flying, evade many missiles and unlock new fighters along the way ! Warning : Fighter pilot spirit required.

477232.overview: If you are considering a career as a marine or army sniper, this is where you begin. The creator of MILITARY SNIPER-SIM, Matthew Reedake, is an ex-soldier of the Australian Army and has studied advanced physics at Sydney University. Designed to allow the practice of all key skills used by snipers and marksmen, it includes environment effects, moving targets, ballistics replay and much more.

477233.overview:
Micromazes is an 8-bit retro style puzzle game which can be played single player or two-player co-op (challenge mode), or two-, three- or four-player versus (race mode). Levels are randomly generated so no two games are ever the same.

To complete the 50 challenge levels you'll have to make use of keys, doors, blocks, targets, teleports, switches and lots lots more!

477234.overview:
Outnumbered, but not outgunned!

Destroy the relentless waves of enemy MiG-15 jet aircraft, and be the Top Gun. Your weapon is the legendary North American F-86 Sabre jet. Play solo or with 1-4 player coop in this fast paced, Korean war era shooter.

Mere survival is not enough - you'll need a severe case of "MiG Madness", and hunger for crazy Power-ups to truly be the best!

477235.overview:
This 2D puzzle platformer invites you to travel vast expanses of time to explore a unique world.

Witness walls crumble before you and erode away as you project yourself into a distant future; see structures rebuild themselves as you travel to a distant past. Use your time travel powers to discover the secrets of your mysterious environment.

477237.overview: Minigolf Mania is a 3D game with over 60 holes on 4 different courses. It comes with four different games modes like Safari and Race mode, and many fun things including Booster Beams, Super Powers, Bouncy Surfaces, Lava, and more!

477238.overview: Modern Pirate Hunter: Ep 1 (Nash's Revenge) is a fast-paced sea combat game with a unique style of action and depth featuring intense dog-fights, a rich 3D world to explore, a multitude of weapons and upgrades, and a thrilling campaign.

477239.overview:
Test your reflexes in this fast-paced, one-button classic. Race through procedurally generated levels, dodging obstacles in your path.

Can you complete the twisted loop that is Mobius?

477240.overview:
Build Miner Sandbox style worlds, then traverse them in interesting and fun ways. Fly, Drive, Walk or use Spider powers to cling to walls, then spider shot to another.

Explore computer generated worlds to find hidden blocks, some hidden blocks have special properties. Some of these properties include starting or stopping a timer, another lets you bounce up and down, what will the others do?

477242.overview: A woman searches the ruins of a Roman Temple for the legend of the Mind's Eye of Jupiter, a hidden portal to another time. Download episode one of this 3D sci-fi adventure game.

477243.overview: Experience the puzzling Minesweeper game with a new modern look. Up to 4 players competitive or CO-OP. Highly customizable games complete with highscores and user statistics.

477245.overview: Now you can enjoy the great American pass-time from the comfort of your couch. Play with up to 3 of your friends and family.

477246.overview:
Prepare yourself to get seriously retro with 26 challenging minigames that make up the Minigame Marathon.

Choose one of four difficulty levels and try to pass the minigames in the fewest attempts and quickest time possible, using the highly-effective but highly-dangerous "fast forward" mode if required.

Playable by one to four players, and includes online score sharing.

477247.overview:
Play as the Minotaur... Wandering the world with your axe, destroying everything that tries to harm you. Chop, smash, combo, block and counter your way through entire armies!

Play co-op with 3 friends locally, or up to 7 friends over Xbox Live.

Unravel the mystery of the mysterious falling rocks from the sky! Paint the ground with the blood of your fallen enemies!

477249.overview: Inspired by Shigeru Miyamoto’s Mario Bros title, Misfit Battles improves upon its spiritual predecessor by adding increased multi-player functionality, levels, monsters, and artwork culminating in the ultimate platform battle based game!

477250.overview: In Memory of the Old Times.....shoot at the birds! And you can also challenge your friends in the Multiplayer mode!

477251.overview: Missing Reel is a co-operative arcade shooter with a "B-Movie" theme. Players must defend themselves against hordes of enemies and survive to the end of the level, when the players must defeat a boss enemy. The game includes three different game modes. There are 5 levels to play through each with their own unique character, enemy and boss.

477252.overview: Alice returns to her own time to confront Tribune and make the choice that will affect the distant future. Download the final episode of this 3D sci-fi adventure game.

477254.overview: Alice is told to journey into the caves under the Roman Temple. Somewhere in the caverns the Dream Guide waits to answer the questions she searches for.

477255.overview:
Miniaturize your Xbox Live Avatar and battle against other Mini Wizards in this spell casting action game.

Includes LIVE multiplayer and single player survival mode with global scoreboard.

477256.overview:
After an emergency landing, Telly's spaceship has been stolen by a strange and dark professor. As Milie, a young mechanic girl, help him to find it back.

Ride your motorbike, fight against a whole army of robots and defeat the professor in this scrolling shooter.

477293.overview: A new Moe Mekuri is here! Just like the previous game, the goal is simply to flip over all the panels face up. Can you complete all the stages and add the cute girls' pictures to the gallery? The higher the difficulty level, the less clothing the girl in the picture will wear! It's a Moe-moe puzzle game that perfectly reflects on the developer's interests!

477295.overview:
How much money can you rack up?

Get a job, make investments, and put some savings aside as your money grows to the top!

477297.overview: This game is as simple as just flipping all the panels to face up. Can you pass all the stages and add the girls' illustrations to the gallery? With the upgrade version, after beating all the stages including the SPECIAL, you can move the breasts of the images for the HARD level in the GALLERY.

477298.overview:
1 year after Moe Mekuri 2, new Moe Mekuri 3 is here with all new cute girls! The game system is the same puzzle game as the previous version.

Can you pass all the stages and get all the illustrations of those girls in your gallery?

Enjoy this moe-moe puzzle game that once you start, you can't stop.

477300.overview: The mole appears one after another. Strike it with the hammer quickly.

477301.overview: Finding a magical portal to another world? Cool! Being killed soon upon arrival? Not cool. Turning into a Were-Zompire (Werewolf + Zombie + Vampire) and gaining amazing power? Very cool! Embarking on an interactive story with many different paths & endings? Totally awesome!

477302.overview: "Monaco 360"is a classic 2d retro by design top down racer inspired by many retro racing games on the Commodore 64 and Arcade formats.

477303.overview:
Lost at night in a monastery in ruins, unarmed and hunted by demons...

A first-person horror experience that is best played with the lights off.

477304.overview:
Do you have spatial awareness and fast reactions?

Plan forward and help your monkey to pass dangerous obstacles. Collect useful bonus items, jump and run and find the way through different landscapes. But be aware of evil monsters chasing you.

Receive awards and work on your highscore list.

477305.overview:
Monkey has lost his nuts!

Help monkey get his nuts back - dodge hazards, defeat enemies and beat the clock through 100 levels.

477307.overview: Choose your favorite monster and give them a voice. Each monster has its own unique style for the ultimate voice changer.

477308.overview:
Help the monkey to get many bananas in this funny puzzle game.

4 levels with a different amount and kinds of coins will keep you and your friends satisfied. And in the future there`s more to come!

477309.overview: Monster Wisp, a puzzle game in which you must find and rescue stranded wisps throughout the woods. While you avoid the dangers that are trying to steal the wisps you are trying to rescue. The game features twenty five levels, some that will test your wits, some that will require quick timing and others that will test your search and rescue skills.

477310.overview: Ever wondered what monkeys play for fun in the jungle? They play the ultimate air board game. Come and join them!

477311.overview:
Monster Katz are on the attack and your best defense is... water?! Good thing Monster Katz hate water, but you better make it last!

Use dozens of water-powered defenses to fend off the monster hoard in 39 exciting levels across 3 unique maps.

Play along to your own tunes or jam with our Monster mix!

477312.overview:
Maxwell T. Monkey is fed up of life in the zoo and desperately wants something fun to do. Going against the wishes of his good conscience Maxwell, egged on by his bad conscience, takes up the sport of poo flinging.

Join Maxwell the schizophrenic monkey and his friends in over 30 levels of poo flinging madness... just don't smell his finger.

Now includes local two player co-op!

477313.overview: Monster Escape is an action-puzzle hybrid where players navigate their monsters safely through levels. Along the way they must make a pathway with puzzle pieces to connect the landscape and avoid a variety of enemies. Each level requires a new approach while still allowing multiple solutions.

477318.overview:
In this twin stick shooter you must shoot and destroy your foe while playing through 32 different challenges . Also use your grapple to swing and hurl monsters into one another.

Upgrade your gun and grapple for more destruction.

477320.overview: Monsters Elect is a 2D fantasy action game. Fight your way through a never ending stream of monsters and lead your allies in battle as you take down four mean bosses.

477321.overview: In this space shooter you will destroy hordes of space monsters using your choice of three different upgradable guns and bombs along with other upgradable abilities. These abilities will give you the edge to survive through the monsters' space and their planet. If you think you're up for it play through the game on hard difficulty using the powerful but dangerous gravity bomb.

477322.overview: Battle your way up to the moon, to get some delicious moon cheese, that not only tastes magnificent it also comes with some bonus effects, and then enjoy as the points just keep coming.

477323.overview: Moon Mining & Drilling Co has hired you to mine valuable resources from deep beneath the moon's surface.

477324.overview: Pilot your way through this unique collection of performed short stories. You drive a Moon Taxi and every passenger has a story to tell. Collect dust and words to unlock the next fare and the next tale.

477325.overview: Immerse yourself in the underworld of the 1920s era prohibition period. 6 Unique game modes, a custom game mode editor, upgradable GUI, unlockable Milestones, and many other features will test your trading skills for a long time to come.

477326.overview: Take control of the massively awesome and super sexy aristocratic demon known only as "The Duke" in an upwards-scrolling platformer where chasing down giant fleeing monsters is the business at hand. Build combos to unleash increasingly magnificent finishing moves on the (most likely) guilty monsters - and impress your adoring fans.

477327.overview: In this twin stick action game you will need to avoid monsters and then smash them to bits with your axe so you can eat them. Monsters Swimming has 25 levels that become more and more challenging and 5 challenge levels that will test your avoiding, smashing and eating skills. So prepare to hack and devour.

477328.overview: Find and match the illusive twin cards to learn Iliana's deepest secrets!

477329.overview: Mortal Legacies is a 2D Japanese Role Playing Game. Explore the world of Elisia in search of the lost crown while fighting powerful foes and finding friends to help you on your quest.

477330.overview: Run, jump and roll to the beat in the easy-to-learn, tricky-to-master most addicting sheep game.Simple side-scrollers with catchy music and cutesy graphics are awesome. And rhythm games rock. In fact, we like them both so much we decided to make them into one. The result? The Most Addicting Sheep Game. It’s an engagingly simple rhythm platformer where jumps and rolls must be perfectly timed to the music to complete the increasingly complex levels with maximum score. Oh, and it has a cute sheep.We loved making TMASG. We love playing TMASG. And we’d love to know if you do too!

477331.overview: MothBallz gives you 14 balls to unlock, each with unique dynamics; 45 testing levels, including Time Trials and KillAll frenzies; a game progression designed to maximize replay value; and that satisfied feeling you can only get from crushing a ton of bugs.

477333.overview:
MSA Julie features a novel combination of two-stick-shooter and motorbike racing game. While helping the French agent Julie Cevoir on her hunt for super villain Dr. Kreutzer you have to master bike physics while clearing the way off enemies.

In twenty increasingly challenging missions preceded by an extensive tutorial the story is told in professionally recorded dialogs and comic stills.

477334.overview: You've got the ultimate racing car, and an unlimited road to drive on. What else do we need to say? It's all about driving. Fast. No brakes, no limits.

477335.overview: Designed to help you improve your joystick control ability, help the mouse safely find his way to the end of the maze. Pick up cheese wedges along the way to satisfy his appetite and increase your score. Keep your mouse away from the edges though; they will zap him!

477336.overview:
"Animation movie puzzle + puzzle with a falling object feel."

Swap the pieces to complete the movie, and all the pieces in that movie will disappear! Clear the pieces quickly, making sure they don't cross the red line.

Pieces on the stage rise one row at a time, giving it a falling object feel.

477337.overview:
Hate having to go outside to mow the lawn? Now you can do it while still indoors!

Armed with a lawn mower and a weed eater, you have the mission of mowing a virtual lawn as fast as you can.

Try not to mow any cats...

477338.overview:
Create music quickly on your Xbox 360. Best viewed as a fun music/sketch toy, Mr BeatLoop lets you create loops using 3 different drum kits and 8 different instruments.

Edit the loops in real time, change the speed, save and load your best ideas!

Designed with absolute ease of use and fun in mind - Mr BeatLoop is great for sketching up quick musical ideas, or just experimenting!

477339.overview: Shift gravity to navigate Mr. Gravity through a series of challenging (and most times perilous) puzzles to find Mrs. Gravity! While moving through these puzzles be sure to collect the gems along the way, but be careful.

477340.overview: Mulletman is a moral man, principled, disciplined, a man of roids and wisdom. Trapped between two worlds, between the eighties and the nineties, he walks the line between the past and the future, between good and gilded robot.

477341.overview:
Play up to 4 continuously shuffling minigames at once, using the entire Xbox 360 Controller.

Last as long as possible, attempt 30 increasingly-difficult Challenges, or try the full-featured Practice Mode.

Great for parties!

477342.overview: Follow The Adventure of the explorer, Gunnthar Svensen, in discovering the treacherous tombs of Egypt!

477343.overview:
The #1 rated Xbox Live Indie Game. Halo-inspired. Destructible/constructible environments. Vehicles. Zombie survival. Hookshots.

Infection mode: Be the zombie & eat the dead to level up your zombie abilities.

477344.overview: There's a battleaxe stuck in the back of Patrick's head!

477346.overview:
Favorite slots games from LiveGLBT.com are now available to everyone. Each with its own mini-game.

Cocktail slots has exciting three real slot action like in a casino. Bright colorful graphics, high quality sound!

Take a trip under the sea in Fish Slots.

Ride'm Cowboys and Cowgals! Mosey on over to Rodeo Slots and take a spin. A great western themed game with a cattle roping mini-game.

477347.overview:
Muffy boy is an arcade platform game. Style of the best retro game Jetset Willy.

Roby kid has lost all Marbles, you must collect all 80 Marbles, and Roby leave your computer.

477348.overview: After the disappearance of an archaeological expedition in an Egyptian tomb, a soldier was sent to find them. His worst nightmare was about to begin...

477349.overview:
You have been invited to a dinner party at Miss Havisham's, a notorious old gossip. But upon arrival, your host is missing and the rest of the guests are exceptionally uncomfortable and oddly behaved.

You determine to get to the root of all their behaviour and to explain the mystery you encounter.

477350.overview: Murky Horizon takes traditional elements like power-ups and upgradeable turrets, and introduces features rarely seen in either genre like four-player coop and pitch-black nightfall. In Murky Horizon players defend a bunker from waves of flesh-eating lizards. As day turns to night, the game grows more challenging and players must use flashlights and flares to spot incoming enemies.

477351.overview:
Murderous Market is a party game of stealth and assassination. Each of up to four players must first find themselves in a town filled with NPCs, then they must find and kill their targets quietly.

Murderous Market has four game modes that use stealth in unique ways. There are outbreaks of plague, werewolves, character specific powers, and customizable settings that make every play different.

477352.overview: In Murphid players must use their puzzle solving skills and fast reaction to withstand attack of gorgeous marble hordes and bring those beasts under control. Deep, yet simple core game mechanics coupled with astonishing graphics, immersive sound effects and adaptive gameplay result in intense climatic moments that modern gamers have come to expect. We hope you dig it!

477353.overview: Simple music sequencer in piano roll style. Enjoy editing and playing as you like.

477354.overview:
The world of Music and Purpleness has been invaded by the Musickness, turning healthy notes Pink and Green!

Do what you can to save as many of them as possible!

477355.overview: Music Box is a new type of music app, focusing on user experience and ease of use.

477356.overview: Music Island is a rhythm game where you make your own music as you play. Take the role of a man trapped on an island and use the beat to defeat waves of incoming sea creatures. Features a full story mode and an infinite mode with global leaderboards.

477357.overview: Brighten up your T.V. this Christmas with our musical advent calendar, featuring 3 advent calendars, puppies, kittens and cartoon pictures all whilst listening to some all time favourite Christmas songs

477358.overview:
MusicNow! is a music jukebox and the fastest way to access your music library on your XBOX.

Utilizing the new SEMpick UI you can find a specific Artist, Album, or Song with fewer keystrokes than any other product available.

477359.overview: This sound action puzzle is put some pieces of panel together to play the music. Connecting four colors of panels on the screen and make it rectangle, and attach to the place called scorezone where the music will be playing. put the panel together well, and let's enjoy music.

477360.overview: This is the Second edition of Musicus. All songs are new one. and can confront in XBOXLive game. This sound action puzzle is put some pieces of panel together to play the music. Connecting four colors of panels on the screen and make it rectangle, and attach to the place called scorezone where the music will be playing. put the panel together well, and let's enjoy music.

477361.overview:
Motocross High Definition. Race your dirtbike against 3 computer controlled bikes on 5 different racetracks.

The bike handling is amazing with the bike power-sliding in turns and the suspensions absorbing every bump on the track. Many stunts allowed including back flip, front flip and many more.

Impressive crashes. Controllable camera. Original Soundtrack.

477362.overview: PLATFORMING NINJA ACTION ** Many levels of platforming action! ** Climb walls and slash enemies! ** Get collectibles and go for fast times!

477365.overview:
Simple to pick up but difficult to master, Muvizzle uses one of the simplest of concepts in number puzzling, but one that offers endless possibilities for strategy and replay.

Tired of in game muzak? Muvizzle bundles an interface to YOUR music collections and a background visualisation to gee you along. Put on the music that YOU want to listen to, relax and perfect your scores in Muvizzle.

477366.overview:
The year is 2012 and the world as we know it has ended. A virus sent from the depths of Hell has decimated humanity. Genetic mutations caused by the virus have turned many of those remaining into mindless zombies with dangerous mutant powers.

Can you survive the zombie onslaught and save humanity from Armageddon?

477372.overview: My Band is a musical game offering to the player the ability to create a band and compose their own music with a Pad or any instruments compatible with the XBox 360.

477373.overview:
The zombie hordes of living dead monsters are hungry, and cat is on the menu. Rascal the cat must use all her nine lives to survive this nightmare.

Kill zombies, build alliances, loot stashes and level up as you fight for survival in a world where cats have inherited human civilization.

477378.overview: Design your ultimate fish tank. Customize wallpapers, rock features, plants, gravels, and pretty much everything. Add more than 18 fish types to your aquarium. Why not create your very own species in the paint fish area? Unlock able rewards to add extra tank features that make this one of the most exciting XNA community products launched to date.

477379.overview: Featuring 10 Christmas carols and our next gen 3d engine. Decorate and light your Christmas tree, stretch out in front of a Yule log fire or get a group of friends together and go Christmas caroling over Xbox Live with your avatars. Experience first hand the awesome magic of Santa arriving, it just wouldn't be myChristmas without him.

477380.overview: Use your wits to defeat your opponents by getting rid of all your cards first. With local and online play, you can share your scores and take on up to 3 opponents via system link, or through xbox live!

477386.overview: Experience a sexy and mysterious adventure in the Mystic Forest!

477390.overview:
Dare you brave the walls of Mythos Castle?

Choose to be the Wizard, Knight or Fairy in this epic platform action adventure.

477393.overview:
Max crash landed onto a mysterious island. After meeting the king of the island, Max accidentally unleashes the evil sorcerer Malwarp who has kidnapped the princess and took over the kingdom. The Staff of Wisdom has chosen Max and has granted him the power to fight back against Malwarp's army of minions.

Help Max find keys and doorways on the journey to reach the top of the mountain and save the princess!

479394.overview:
Monster management! Sim action gameplay.

Unholy Heights is a combination of Tower Defense strategy and Apartment Management Simulation.

Sucker monsters into moving into your building, charge them rent and keep them happy by buying them furniture.

Heroes will attempt to attack your apartments so when they do, call on your monsters to take them out!

481458.overview: Discover the world of iterated function systems in this game/gallery combo. Mirrors and Nodes are placed in each level. You must guess the position of the Nodes when reflected across the Mirrors. With multiple Mirrors, Nodes are reflected across all Mirrors in numerical order. Score is based on accuracy. Meet each Level's score goal to unlock new art.

481495.overview: Rotate the cube and change the cubes color to match the incoming shapes. Simple right? Features include arcade and endurance modes, full HD graphics and online high scores.

482426.overview: A Kinect Fun Labs music toy that turns the floor into a giant virtual keyboard. Steps and foot movements play notes using a choice of sounds, including instruments and recordings of your own voice.

482460.overview: A Kinect Fun Labs experience that changes the player's appearance with comic visual distortions. Moving in front of the sensor reveals different mutations and creates unusual animated portraits.
